cuts.ofreeRecent: a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — holds her keepsake at chest height; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a sunlit white marble temple — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a wooden river dock above calm water — standing; a mirrored dance — holds a water bottle at chest height; an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — standing; overgrown jungle temple ruins — kneeling on the ground; a misty enchanted garden of moss — standing; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — standing; a walled garden with a lotus pond — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; a narrow city alley with hanging signboards and wet pavement — standing
